verdict.rationale: FireHydrant documents registrable outbound webhooks that fire on internal events and send data to external systems (docs-68). Webhooks can be configured via the API (docs-21, docs-81), and the docs also describe Signals webhook alert targets (docs-72) and a runbook 'send a webhook' step (docs-71). Missing for 10: details of the subscribable event catalog, payload schema and signature verification are not shown in the evidence, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
